title: App Vault
summary: App Vault is a one-stop spot for all most frequently used features and info.
description:
With App vault, you can get access to great tools and widgets with just one swipe. Shortcuts, weather and calendar widgets, and news are all in one place — no need to open extra apps. App vault's simple, clean design and customization options put the information you need at the forefront. You can even open other apps with one tap from App vault.

Download App vault now to enjoy all its great features!

This version of App vault is compatible with MIUI versions 11, 12, and 12.5.

Shortcuts
Open your favorite and frequently-used apps with a single tap.

Weather
Check the current weather and multi-day forecast at a glance.

News
View headlines and stories from around the world, including sports, technology, entertainment, and business.

Health
Record and view your personal health data with ease for a fitter, healthier life.

Discover what you can do with App vault!
